questions.text: Could you describe exactly what is not working?
When did you first notice the problem?

questions.translation: Týká se to i jiných zařízení?

questions.text: Has anything changed at your workstation recently?
Can you use any other services, such as printing?

causes.cable: The physical connection was incomplete or its port was unavailable.
causes.vlan: The workstation was connected to the wrong network segment.
causes.dhcp: The address pool had no free leases.
causes.arp: The workstation was still using an old gateway address in its neighbour cache.
causes.dns: The name lookup still used an outdated service address.
causes.https: The web service or its access rule prevented HTTPS connections.
causes.wifi: The access point position did not provide coverage at both work areas.

interventions.cable: I moved the connection to a working port.
interventions.vlan: I corrected the port network assignment.
interventions.dhcp: I made addresses available and renewed the lease.
interventions.arp: I refreshed the outdated neighbour entry.
interventions.dns: I corrected the name lookup data and refreshed the client cache as needed.
interventions.https: I restored the HTTPS service and its specific access rule as needed.
interventions.wifi: I moved the access point and checked both work areas.

missions.title: Firemní portál po změně sítě
missions.symptom: I can sign in locally, but the company portal will not open.
missions.cause: Klientský port je ve VLAN 20 a portál používá starý překlad jména.
missions.review: Obnov správný segment, dynamický pronájem a překlad aktuálního portálu; zopakuj všechny služby a kontrolní zařízení.

missions.title: Přesunuté pracoviště a tisk
missions.symptom: Since my desk was moved, I cannot print or open the company portal.
missions.cause: Nedostupný port PC 04 a tiskárna v nesprávné VLAN.
missions.review: Obnov fyzickou trasu PC 04, správné přiřazení tiskárny, úplný DHCP a služby obou stanic.
